items.name: Node patch release
items.where: .nvmrc holds the major line; setup-node check-latest

items.name: pnpm (packageManager)
items.howToBump: set packageManager to the new version, run pnpm install, then the gate

items.name: gitleaks
items.howToBump: update GITLEAKS_VERSION and GITLEAKS_SHA256 in .github/workflows/secrets.yml from the release checksums file

items.name: zizmor
items.howToBump: update ZIZMOR_VERSION and ZIZMOR_SHA256 (the manylinux x86_64 wheel hash from PyPI) in .github/workflows/ci.yml

items.name: tesseract (public/vendor/tesseract)
items.where: a hand copy of tesseract.js and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, whose packages Dependabot updates: when it bumps them, copy the new files into public/vendor/tesseract and run pnpm run sri:update, until the files are loaded from the installed packages

items.name: Cropper.js 1.6.2 (public/vendor/cropper)
items.where: hand copy; until it is loaded from the cropperjs package, check its releases when the vendor files are touched

items.name: Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 (public/vendor/fontawesome)
items.where: hand copy; until the icons come from a package, check its releases when the vendor files are touched
